name: Cloud Infrastructure Incident Runbooks
description: Verified SRE incident remediation procedures for database connection saturation, cache memory watermarks, and TLS certificate renewal.

corpus.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Saturation
corpus.text: When active PostgreSQL connections reach 100, the pool is saturated. Engineers must immediately restart pgbouncer using systemctl restart pgbouncer. Terminate lingering idle connections using pg_terminate_backend with a 60 second timeout.

corpus.title: Redis Memory High Watermark & Eviction
corpus.text: When Redis memory usage exceeds 90 percent of allocated RAM, verify the cache eviction policy is set to allkeys-lru. Never issue FLUSHALL on production clusters without authorization from the Incident Commander.

corpus.title: TLS Certificate Auto-Renewal & Reload
corpus.text: Certificates are renewed 30 days prior to expiration. After certbot completes, execute nginx -s reload to reload SSL certificates with zero dropped TCP connections. Do not restart the nginx service directly during high traffic windows.

corpus.title: Kubernetes OOMKilled Pod Diagnostics
corpus.text: Pods terminating with Exit Code 137 are OOMKilled by the Linux kernel. Before increasing memory limits in deployment specs, capture a heap dump using jcmd or inspect container cgroup memory.max limits.

corpus.title: Kafka Consumer Lag Remediation
corpus.text: Consumer lag exceeding 10,000 messages triggers a P2 warning alert. Scale consumer replicas to match partition count. Ensure partition reassignment does not trigger rebalance storms during peak throughput.

corpus.title: SRE Incident Escalation Matrix
corpus.text: P1 critical outages require a 15 minute primary on-call response SLA. If the primary on-call does not acknowledge the pager within 5 minutes, escalate to the secondary engineer on the emergency bridge.

items.question: What should an engineer do when PostgreSQL active connections reach 100?
reference_answers: Restart pgbouncer and terminate idle connections with 60 second timeout

items.question: What eviction policy must be set when Redis memory exceeds 90 percent?

reference_answers: Execute nginx -s reload for zero dropped TCP connections

items.question: What is the response SLA for P1 critical outages?

reference_answers: Use jcmd to capture a heap dump
